__NOTOC__ {{recipesummary|category=Meat recipes | Yield = 12 burritos|time=Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 8–10 hours
Stand time: 10 minutes|difficulty=3 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|Cuisine of the USA]] | [[Cookbook:Chili|Chili]] ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]] * 4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], minced * 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] (~1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) * 1 jar (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) medium chunky [[Cookbook:Salsa|salsa]] * 1 jar (16 ounces) mild chunky salsa * 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Lime|lime juice]] * 1 bunch fresh [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]], chopped (~1 cup) * 8 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|scallions]], chopped (~1 cup) * 1 medium [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]], chopped (~1 cup) * ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Lemon Pepper|lemon pepper]] seasoning * ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]] * ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]]) boneless [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] loin roast, tied or netted * 1 can (4 ounces) [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|green chiles]] * 12 ea. 10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Flour Tortilla|flour tortillas]] * 8 ounces (~2 cups) shredded [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack cheese]] ==Procedure== # Heat oil in 12-inch [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat. # Add garlic and onion and cook until tender. # Stir the next 10 ingredients into the skillet. # Put the pork roast into a 5-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|slow cooker]]. Cover roast with salsa mixture. # Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or until meat is fork-tender. # Remove roast and let stand 10 minutes on [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|cutting board]]. # Shred pork with forks. # Transfer 5 cups salsa mixture from cooker into 2-quart [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Stir in chiles. # Cook over medium heat to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. # Reduce heat to medium-low. # Cook and stir 15 minutes to thicken mixture. # Spoon a cup of shredded pork down center of each tortilla. # Top with 2 tablespoons green chile sauce. # Roll sides of tortilla over and then fold up ends to hold filling. # Cover burritos with rest of green chile sauce and cheese.
